check_anchor_inside_flags: check whether anchors are inside the image border using anchor_inside_flags with flat_anchors and valid_flags
filter_anchors_by_border: filter anchors by allowed border using anchor_inside_flags with a custom allowed_border value
calculate_proportional_bbox_region: calculate a proportional bounding box region using calc_region with a given ratio and bbox tensor
calculate_region_with_clipping: calculate a proportional bbox region clipped to feature map size using calc_region with featmap_size
review_anchor_utils: review the anchor_inside_flags and calc_region utility functions for object detection prior generation
